people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Now Solomon decided to build a house for Yahweh’s name, and a house for his kingdom.
translations.bsb: Now Solomon purposed to build a house for the Name of the LORD and a royal palace for himself.
translations.kjv: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
translations.asv: Now Solomon purposed to build a house for the name of Jehovah, and a house for his kingdom.
